tools.name: save_websites
tools.description: Save websites to the user's Moodmark library, optionally into a collection (created if missing). Moodmark captures a screenshot, title, favicon, fonts and tech stack for each; the colour palette is extracted when the user opens the library. Up to 50 URLs per call. Already-saved sites are not duplica

tools.name: search_library
tools.description: Find bookmarks the user already saved — by text (title, URL, note, tags, fonts, tech), colour family, tags or collection. Returns newest first.

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: The user's collections with bookmark counts and links.

tools.name: create_collection
tools.description: Create an empty collection (returns the existing one if the name is taken).

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: The user's tags by category (industry, style, layout…). Only these names can be applied when saving.

tools.name: get_design_brief
tools.description: Turn one saved reference into design.md: palette roles, typography, layout, components, a paste-ready prompt for AI builders (v0, Cursor, Lovable, Bolt) and CSS/Tailwind tokens. Cached on the bookmark; Premium only.

tools.name: update_bookmarks
tools.description: Additive edits to saved bookmarks: add existing tags, append a note, add to a collection (created if missing). Never removes anything the user set.

tools.name: suggest_tags
tools.description: AI tag suggestions for up to 10 saved bookmarks, chosen from the user's own tags, each with a short reason. Suggestions only; apply the ones that fit with update_bookmarks.

tools.name: share_collection
tools.description: Turn on the public, read-only link for a collection so it can be sent to a client (they can browse and vote). Only call this when the user explicitly asks to share.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_library · Private data: get_design_brief · Public sink: share_collection.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_library · Private data: get_design_brief · Public sink: share_collection

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
